document.title: Acquisition or Abandonment of Secured Property
document.issued_by: lender who acquired, or knew of the abandonment of, property securing its loan

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: Marks this statement as correcting one already furnished for the same year.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: Printed on Copy A only; a filer's mark, never a figure.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: The filer's own account number; identification only.

boxes.label: Date of lender’s acquisition or knowledge of abandonment
boxes.notes: The face sets boxes 1 and 2 side by side, so both captions wrap into each other in the text renderings; the caption is the face's own.

boxes.label: Balance of principal outstanding
boxes.notes: 'Shows the debt (principal only) owed to the lender on the loan when the interest in the property was acquired by the lender or on the date the lender first knew or had reason to know that the property was abandoned.'

boxes.label: Fair market value of property
boxes.notes: 'If the amount in box 4 is less than the amount in box 2, and your debt is canceled, you may have cancellation of debt income.'

boxes.label: Check if the borrower was personally liable for repayment of the debt
boxes.notes: Copy A's caption; Copy B prints 'If checked, the borrower was personally liable for repayment of the debt'.

document.notes: A 1099-A reports an EVENT, not income: gain or loss on the acquisition is the borrower's basis against the debt canceled (or the sale proceeds), and any cancellation-of-debt income usually arrives on a Form 1099-C. Losses on personal-use property are not deductible.

extraction.note: No structured model is bound: no Azure prebuilt-tax model for this form is recorded anywhere in this repo (schema, notes or the 068 model re-verification), and a model name is never guessed. The page is read by the generic reader.
